records.finding: System.loadLibrary success returns true. Exception and UnsatisfiedLinkError are logged at Unity level 6 and return false. records.finding: FMOD uses max(round(minBuffer*1.1)&~3, fmodInfo(j)*fmodInfo(i)*4), a six-int AudioTrack constructor, getState()==1, and native fmodProcess before byte-array write. Failed initialization releases and decrements an initial three-attempt budget; success resets it. This method ignores fmodProcess/write return values. No claim of selected backend, audible output, or effective-ring getter coverage.
